fusions.name: Trampling Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 7 tiles to the target and tramples it for 14 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Dust Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of grit ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Pace
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tireless Plates
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
